title: AStitchInLanguageModels: Dataset and Methods for the Exploration of Idiomaticity in Pre-Trained Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the linguistic challenge of idiomaticity in language models. While a single example sentence mentions a religious concept ('Let the Word of God be our life vest...'), this is incidental and used to illustrate a linguistic point ('Meta Usage'). The core work does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
